description: Intent i029 (peer-trusted-transport, snapshot s07) complete. FINDING (medium confidence): s07:drivers/greybus/gb-beagleplay.c:204-214 — hdlc_rx_greybus_frame() extracts the peer MCU's HDLC-framed Greybus header field gb_msg_len = le16_to_cpu(gb_frame->hdr.size) (line 208) and passes it verbatim as the delivered length to greybus_data_rcvd() (line 213), while the locally known real frame length len = bg->rx_buffer_len - 4 computed by hdlc_rx_frame() (lines 439/450) is never used; gb_msg_len is never compared to len, the fixed 258-byte rx_buffer (MAX_RX_HDLC = 1+256+CRC_LEN, lines 23-25/83), or any kernel-known maximum. Downstream validation is vacuous for this caller: gb_connection_recv() (operation.c:1027-1066) re-reads msg_size = le16_to_cpu(header.size) from the same peer bytes (line 1049) so 'if (size < msg_size)' (line 1050) cannot fail. Consuming use: gb_operation_create_incoming() memcpy(operation->request->header, data, size) (operation.c:652) copies peer-declared size bytes out of the fixed rx_buffer past the accumulated frame — heap OOB read into a message buffer capped by hd->buffer_size_max; the response direction (operation.c:987-1012) is capped by message_size, making the request path the asymmetric one. Counterevidence: hdlc_rx (481-483) and cc1352_bootloader_rx (620-633) bound every byte store into rx_buffer, so the unchecked propagation is only at 208/213; sibling driver es2.c:830-841 delivers HCI-bounded urb->actual_length, showing the API is safe with a bounded caller. Candidates classified: es2.c:840 safe; hv_balloon.c:1349 safe for this invariant (range_count walks within static PAGE_SIZE recv_buffer; PFN misuse is a host-trust concern, not re-reported here); net/9p/trans_virtio.c:146 safe (rc.size flag + msize/parse_header bounds); drivers/block/nbd.c:872 safe (tag/cookie validated, bvec-bounded); drivers/net/virtio_net.c:1241 safe (truesize/MAX_SKB_FRAGS bounded); qcom_glink_native.c:920 structurally checked (chunk_size validated at line 923 against avail; intentless kmalloc(chunk_size+left_size) at 952) but the s07 smem instance was not deep-read to a conclusion. Limitations: bounded sweep — vhost/vringh, 9p trans_fd/rdma/xen/usbg, rpmsg virtio/mtk/smd, mctp, ntb, xen pvcalls, ceph/cifs reply parsers, ethernet admin queues only enumerated; no runtime reproducer (read-only tree, serdev peer hardware required); impact bounded to heap OOB read with userspace exfiltration untraced. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i029.json (snapshots_checked ["s07"], execution_status complete, 1 finding, 9 candidates).
